scenes.tts: The dial is the B M P side of the choice between skin and neural. In frog caps and in the whole embryo, F G F is needed too. Where else does the rule stop?
scenes.caption: The dial is the BMP side of the choice between skin and neural. In frog caps and in the whole embryo, FGF is needed too. Where else does the rule stop?
scenes.visual: Title card: Where the Rule Stops. The dial with an FGF-dependent input arrow beside it and three markers at its edges. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: The dial is the BMP side of the choice between skin and neural. In frog caps and in the whole embryo, FGF is needed too. Where else does the rule stop?

scenes.tts: First limit: it says neural, not where. Noggin caps made forebrain and cement gland markers.
scenes.visual: Noggin-treated caps colored only at the head end of a head-to-tail bar. Labels: forebrain (neural), cement gland (non-neural, head end).
scenes.narration: First limit: it says neural, not where. Noggin caps made forebrain and cement gland markers.

scenes.tts: They made no hindbrain or spinal cord markers. Neural tissue made by Noggin in caps is anterior.
scenes.visual: The hindbrain and spinal cord segments of the bar stay grey. Label: anterior only.
scenes.narration: They made no hindbrain or spinal cord markers. Neural tissue made by Noggin in caps is anterior.

scenes.tts: This fits an older idea from Nieuwkoop: two steps, activation and transformation.
scenes.visual: Label: Nieuwkoop, activation and transformation.
scenes.narration: This fits an older idea from Nieuwkoop: two steps, activation and transformation.

scenes.tts: Activation makes ectoderm neural and anterior. Transformation shifts part of it toward hindbrain and spinal cord.
scenes.visual: Arrow 1, activation: ectoderm to anterior neural. Arrow 2, transformation: part of it shifts toward the tail end.
scenes.narration: Activation makes ectoderm neural and anterior. Transformation shifts part of it toward hindbrain and spinal cord.

scenes.tts: In molecular terms, the B M P antagonists look like activators.
scenes.caption: In molecular terms, the BMP antagonists look like activators.
scenes.visual: Noggin and Chordin icons sit on the activation arrow.
scenes.narration: In molecular terms, the BMP antagonists look like activators.

scenes.tts: Wnt signals, F G Fs and retinoic acid are leading candidates for transformation.
scenes.caption: Wnt signals, FGFs and retinoic acid are leading candidates for transformation.
scenes.visual: Wnt, FGF and retinoic acid arrows point at the posterior end of the bar.
scenes.narration: Wnt signals, FGFs and retinoic acid are leading candidates for transformation.

scenes.tts: The spinal cord may follow a different order. Much of it may come from progenitors made posterior before they become neural.
scenes.visual: Mouse lineage-tracing cartoon: progenitors at the tail end take on a posterior color, then turn neural.
scenes.narration: The spinal cord may follow a different order. Much of it may come from progenitors made posterior before they become neural.

scenes.tts: Second limit: the chick. Read blindly, the rule says blocking B M P anywhere should make neural tissue.
scenes.caption: Second limit: the chick. Read blindly, the rule says blocking BMP anywhere should make neural tissue.
scenes.visual: A chick epiblast disc. The future neural plate is outlined in the middle.
scenes.narration: Second limit: the chick. Read blindly, the rule says blocking BMP anywhere should make neural tissue.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-eight, Claudio Stern's laboratory made Chordin in chick epiblast outside the future neural plate. Do those cells turn neural?
scenes.caption: In 1998, Claudio Stern's laboratory made Chordin in chick epiblast outside the future neural plate. Do those cells turn neural?
scenes.visual: Label: 1998, Stern laboratory. Chordin-expressing cells outside the neural plate. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: In 1998, Claudio Stern's laboratory made Chordin in chick epiblast outside the future neural plate. Do those cells turn neural?

scenes.tts: No. They made no early neural markers. Blocking B M P there was not sufficient.
scenes.caption: No. They made no early neural markers. Blocking BMP there was not sufficient.
scenes.visual: The Chordin cells stay non-neural. Label: not sufficient.
scenes.narration: No. They made no early neural markers. Blocking BMP there was not sufficient.

scenes.tts: Yet Chordin did stabilize early neural markers in cells that had already received neural-inducing signals.
scenes.visual: Cells inside the neural plate keep their neural color longer with Chordin.
scenes.narration: Yet Chordin did stabilize early neural markers in cells that had already received neural-inducing signals.

scenes.tts: In two thousand, Andrea Streit and colleagues looked earlier. F G F signaling before gastrulation is needed to begin neural induction in chick.
scenes.caption: In 2000, Andrea Streit and colleagues looked earlier. FGF signaling before gastrulation is needed to begin neural induction in chick.
scenes.visual: Label: 2000, Streit and colleagues. An FGF arrow acts on the epiblast before gastrulation.
scenes.narration: In 2000, Andrea Streit and colleagues looked earlier. FGF signaling before gastrulation is needed to begin neural induction in chick.

scenes.tts: In two thousand one, Sara Wilson and colleagues added Wnt. Its state decides how epiblast cells respond to F G F.
scenes.caption: In 2001, Sara Wilson and colleagues added Wnt. Its state decides how epiblast cells respond to FGF.
scenes.visual: Label: 2001, Wilson and colleagues, Edlund laboratory. Wnt state switches the FGF response between neural and epidermal.
scenes.narration: In 2001, Sara Wilson and colleagues added Wnt. Its state decides how epiblast cells respond to FGF.

scenes.tts: So in chick, two more inputs join the dial. One is early F G F. The other is a Wnt state that lets cells answer it.
scenes.caption: So in chick, two more inputs join the dial. One is early FGF. The other is a Wnt state that lets cells answer it.
scenes.visual: A single round dial labeled Smad1 in the nucleus, with two extra arrows beside it labeled early FGF and Wnt state. Label: two more inputs.
scenes.narration: So in chick, two more inputs join the dial. One is early FGF. The other is a Wnt state that lets cells answer it.

scenes.tts: Third limit: the mouse. Embryos lacking both chordin and noggin have severe forebrain defects.
scenes.visual: Mouse embryo with the forebrain region missing. Label: no chordin, no noggin.
scenes.narration: Third limit: the mouse. Embryos lacking both chordin and noggin have severe forebrain defects.

scenes.tts: Yet they still form other neural tissue. So the two are needed for a normal forebrain, but not for all neural tissue.
scenes.visual: A schematic mouse embryo: posterior neural tube still present and colored blue, forebrain region missing. No claim that the rest is normal.
scenes.narration: Yet they still form other neural tissue. So the two are needed for a normal forebrain, but not for all neural tissue.

scenes.tts: A fair summary: B M P inhibition is needed for the frog neural plate and for mouse forebrain.
scenes.caption: A fair summary: BMP inhibition is needed for the frog neural plate and for mouse forebrain.
scenes.visual: Summary card, line 1: needed for frog neural plate, mouse forebrain.
scenes.narration: A fair summary: BMP inhibition is needed for the frog neural plate and for mouse forebrain.

scenes.tts: In chick epiblast, it is not sufficient on its own. None of this shows the frog results were wrong.
scenes.visual: Summary card, line 2: not sufficient in chick epiblast. Line 3: the frog results stand.
scenes.narration: In chick epiblast, it is not sufficient on its own. None of this shows the frog results were wrong.

scenes.tts: So, back to the one idea. In early frog caps, B M P says skin. Turn its signal down far enough, and competent cells become neural, as long as other inputs such as F G F are intact.
scenes.caption: So, back to the one idea. In early frog caps, BMP says skin. Turn its signal down far enough, and competent cells become neural, as long as other inputs such as FGF are intact.
scenes.visual: A single round dial labeled Smad1 in the nucleus, high (skin) at one end and low (neural) at the other, with three hands reaching for it: outside the cell, at the membrane, inside the cell. A separate arrow labeled FGF-dependent input feeds the neural side. Text on screen: in early frog caps, BMP says skin; turn its signal down far enough and competent cells become neural, with other inputs such as FGF intact.
scenes.narration: So, back to the one idea. In early frog caps, BMP says skin. Turn its signal down far enough, and competent cells become neural, as long as other inputs such as FGF are intact.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: the dial is the B M P branch of the choice between skin and neural. F G F and competence are part of that choice too, in caps and embryos. Where the tissue lies along the body, and how chick and mouse differ, are further questions.
scenes.caption: The takeaway: the dial is the BMP branch of the choice between skin and neural. FGF and competence are part of that choice too, in caps and embryos. Where the tissue lies along the body, and how chick and mouse differ, are further questions.
scenes.visual: A single round dial labeled Smad1 in the nucleus, with two inputs feeding the same skin-or-neural decision beside it: FGF-dependent signaling and competence (timing). An outer ring of separate labels: position, chick, mouse. Takeaway on screen.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: the dial is the BMP branch of the choice between skin and neural. FGF and competence are part of that choice too, in caps and embryos. Where the tissue lies along the body, and how chick and mouse differ, are further questions.
